This game has some potential to be good, but it's not there yet. 

I know a lot of people hated the tutorial stages, but I actually found them enjoyable. I even enjoyed dogfighting for co-pilots. What really needs work, though, is Warzone and unit balance. 

Most Warzones are fairly easy to do, but two of them are quite close to impossible to even attempt without following a specific method to set up, grab power-ups, and place specific units in certain areas. 

As for units, there's not much leeway - you either use the same six units as everyone else, or you're screwed (you can choose 3 of the 9 safely, basically).

There's not really much variety, either, so locking you to specific units and forcing you to learn specific patterns to repeat specific days or on specific maps against others doesn't only become boring very quickly, it can even make the game downright unfun in how harshly it punishes non-conformity (i.e. fun).

Sure, you can pick it up for some fun for a few hours, but, after you start having to do the same thing the same way everyone else does it every day, you'll feel like every second spent on here was time wasted you'll never get back.
